title: Issue2Test: Generating Reproducing Test Cases from Issue Reports
datasets: SWE-bench Verified subset of 90 SWT-Bench Lite issues
task: Generate issue-specific reproducing tests that fail on buggy code and pass after patch, with execution-guided refinement.
input_setting: GitHub issue + buggy repository/version + inferred root-cause hypotheses + generated project test guidelines + located source/test files; run test in per-project Docker environment, classify failures, refine and rank.
author_relationship_evidence: Paper §4 Reproducibility explicitly names Issue2Test implementation and links official repository; repository README has matching title, method description and SWT-bench-lite results.
license: No root license verified; repository API reports no license. LICENSE files found only under bundled swe-bench-docker dependencies and do not establish a license for Issue2Test itself.
exact_models: Paper main result: GPT-4o-mini snapshot 2024-07-18; additional Llama 3.3 70B Bedrock meta.llama3-3-70b-instruct-v1:0 and Claude 3.5 Sonnet 20241022.
Public config defaults to mutable gpt-4o-mini alias; no finetuned weights.
weights_status: No finetuned weights. Proprietary OpenAI/Anthropic API required for headline result; Bedrock Llama route is hosted inference, not locally pinned weights.
evaluation_route: Public source includes issue_to_test_generation generation/localization/feedback loop, SWT-Bench-Lite instance data, swe-bench-docker per-instance build/evaluation scripts, generated results and comparison outputs. Requirements describe Conda environment and Docker. Static inspected config.yaml, main.py, feedback_loop.py, llm_invocation.py, README; no code executed and no API call made.
blockers: GPT-4o-mini dated model snapshot in paper is not selected by public default config, which uses mutable gpt-4o-mini alias; reproducing exact reported result requires model/version route and API access.

Public YAML hardcodes author-machine absolute paths; needs environment configuration. YAML sets MAX_ITERATIONS=3 while feedback loop source and paper Algorithm 1 state max 20, requiring reconciliation of actual experiment settings.

Paper v4 contains conflicting metrics: abstract says 32.9% (Claude), while Table 2 gives 30.4% GPT-4o-mini and 32.9% Claude; introduction also says 40.1% relative improvement/91 cases while Table 2 attributes 91 to Claude and says GPT model 84. Conclusion claims 28 unique cases and 68.3%, inconsistent with earlier introduction’s 20 unique/60.4%. Pin version/cohort before claiming exact reproduction.
Full Docker builds/runs across 276 historic project environments are substantial; two Sphinx images failed to build in paper evaluation.
concept_fit: High for root-cause hypothesis generation, project/context extraction and execution-grounded behavioral oracle validation; directly relevant to bug-revealing test generation, though it does not formalize a reusable concept representation.
recommendation: Strong SWT-Bench Lite candidate and close prior work for issue-to-reproducing-test generation. Author implementation and cached results are public, but exact rerun is conditional on matching GPT-4o-mini snapshot, reconciling iteration/config and contradictory reported numbers, and rebuilding Docker environments. Do not treat as Defects4J/BugsInPy evidence.
supporting_locations: Paper §§2–4, Table 1–2, Algorithm 1; official fulltext cache SHA-256 070b6fa1dc0c4668226ed4c816864b240447940c705fa49e957cc4a896091a79

Public tree has no repository-root LICENSE; GitHub repository API license=null.
